1000.description: A single-leg calf raise with a band, rising onto the ball of the foot. It trains the calves.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place the band around the ball of your foot.
Hold onto a stable object for balance.
Slowly raise your heel off the ground, lifting your body weight onto the ball of your foot.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other leg.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开站立，与臀部同宽，将弹力带放在脚掌周围。
抓住稳定的物体以保持平衡。
慢慢地将脚跟抬离地面，将身体重量转移到脚掌上。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将脚跟放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换另一条腿。

1064.description: A bodyweight squat in a wide stance with toes turned out. It targets the glutes and inner thighs.
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out.
Hold your hands together at your chest.
Sit your hips down and back between your legs.
Keep your knees over your toes and chest upright.
Lower to thigh level.
Push through your heels to stand and squeeze your glutes.

1128.description: A push-up with your hands in unstable straps, making the chest, arms and core work harder.
instructions: Hold the handles and get into a plank with hands under shoulders.
Keep your body in one line.
Lower your chest between the handles.
Keep the straps steady and elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press up to straight arms.
Do not let the hips sag.

1256.description: A reverse-grip bench press on a decline bench. It trains the lower chest and triceps.
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured and your head lower than your hips.
Grasp the barbell with a reverse grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the barbell and lower it slowly towards your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the barbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 躺在倾斜的长凳上，双脚固定，头部低于臀部。
反握抓住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
松开杠铃，慢慢将其降低到胸部，保持肘部内收。
在底部停顿片刻，然后将杠铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1320.description: A seated cable row using a rope so your hands can cross and finish wide. It works the upper back and lats with a longer range of motion.
instructions: Sit on the rowing machine with your feet flat on the footrests and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the cable ropes with an overhand grip, palms facing each other.
Lean back slightly, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the cable ropes towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the peak of the movement, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在划船机上，双脚平放在脚踏板上，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住缆绳，手掌相对。
稍微向后倾斜，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将缆绳拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1384.description: A one-leg calf raise on a hack machine. It lets you train each calf on its own under a supported load.
instructions: Adjust the sled machine to an appropriate weight.
Stand on the sled machine with one foot, keeping the other foot off the ground.
Hold onto the handles for stability.
Raise your heel as high as possible, lifting your body up on the ball of your foot.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Switch legs and repeat the exercise.
instructionsZh: 将雪橇机调整到合适的重量。
一脚站在雪橇机上，另一只脚离开地面。
握住手柄以保持稳定性。
尽可能高地抬高脚跟，用脚掌抬起身体。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将脚跟放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
换腿并重复练习。

1448.description: Hold a barbell overhead behind you while lying on a bench. It builds lat and chest control in the stretched position.
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a light barbell above your chest with arms nearly straight.
Lower the bar back over your head until you feel a deep stretch in your lats.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down and your elbows softly bent.
Hold the position for 15-30 seconds without letting the bar drift.
Return the bar over your chest with control and set it down safely.

1512.description: On all fours you pull one foot toward your glutes to stretch the front of the thigh. It eases tight quads.
instructions: Start on all fours with your hands directly under your shoulders and your knees directly under your hips.
Extend one leg straight back, keeping your knee bent and your foot flexed.
Slowly lower your hips towards the ground, feeling a stretch in your quads.
Hold this position for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat the stretch on the other side.
instructionsZh: 从四肢着地开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，膝盖直接放在臀部下方。
将一条腿向后伸直，保持膝盖弯曲和脚弯曲。
慢慢地将臀部降低到地面，感觉股四头肌的伸展。
保持这个姿势20-30秒。
换腿并在另一侧重复拉伸。

1576.description: Lying on your back with one leg raised, you draw it toward you to stretch the hamstring.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended.
Bend one knee and bring it towards your chest, holding onto your thigh or shin.
Straighten your leg as much as possible while keeping it elevated.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Repeat with the other leg.
instructionsZh: 平躺，双腿伸展。
弯曲一侧膝盖，将其靠近胸部，握住大腿或小腿。
尽可能伸直腿，同时保持腿抬高。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
换另一条腿重复上述步骤。

1640.description: A one-arm hammer preacher curl with a rope on a cable. It targets the brachialis and the biceps on one side.
instructions: Attach a rope handle to a low pulley cable machine.
Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the rope handle with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Position your upper arm against the preacher bench pad, keeping your elbow slightly bent.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged throughout the exercise.
Slowly curl the rope handle towards your shoulder, keeping your upper arm stationary.
Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the rope handle back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 将绳索手柄连接到低滑轮电缆机器上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
反手握住绳索手柄，手掌朝上。
将上臂靠在牧师凳垫上，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
在整个练习过程中保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与其中。
慢慢地将绳索手柄卷向肩膀，保持上臂静止。
在动作的最高点挤压二头肌，然后慢慢将绳柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1704.description: A wood chop done on one leg that adds a balance challenge to the core rotation.
instructions: Stand on one leg holding a medicine ball overhead to one side.
Chop the ball diagonally down across your body.
Rotate your torso and pivot your standing foot.
Return the ball overhead with control.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.

1832.description: Tilting your head diagonally forward stretches the back and side of the neck. It targets the muscle running from the neck to the shoulder blade.
instructions: Sit tall and gently turn your head about 45 degrees to one side.
Drop your chin diagonally toward your chest, using your hand for light added pressure.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1896.description: A standing stretch with one leg raised on a support that opens the inner thigh.
instructions: Stand tall and place one foot on a bench or raised surface to the side.
Keep your standing leg straight and your toes forward.
Shift your weight toward the raised leg side until you feel a stretch.
Keep your chest upright and your hips square.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

1960.description: Kneeling and sitting back onto your heels to stretch the front of the shins and ankles.
instructions: Kneel on a mat with your feet pointing straight back and the tops of the feet on the floor.
Slowly sit back toward your heels until you feel the shins and ankles stretch.
Place your hands on the floor in front of you to control the pressure.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2088.description: Using a towel behind the back to ease the shoulders into a deeper stretch.
instructions: Hold a towel in one hand and raise that arm overhead, bending the elbow.
Reach the other hand up from behind your back and grab the towel.
Gently pull the towel down with the lower hand.
Keep your head upright.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2152.description: A plank hold while one leg kicks back against a band, working the glutes and core together.
instructions: Place a band around your feet or ankles and get into a forearm or high plank.
Brace your core so your body forms a straight line.
Kick one leg back and up against the band without shifting your hips.
Return the leg with control.
Alternate legs, keeping your hips level throughout.

2344.description: A side-by-side form check for back position during a crunch, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands by your head.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your lower back stays gently on the floor while only the upper back curls up.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

2408.description: Lying face down with a harness on your head, you lift against added weight to strengthen the muscles at the back of the neck.
instructions: Lie face down on a bench with your head past the edge and the weighted harness fitted.
Start with your chin tucked toward your chest.
Raise your head slowly until your face looks forward.
Pause, then lower back under control.
Use a light weight and smooth reps, never jerking the neck.

2664.description: A plate-loaded seated row machine with a chest pad that builds the mid back and lats.
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with your mid chest.
Sit with your chest against the pad and grip the handles.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze the shoulder blades.
Pause briefly, then return slowly.
Keep your torso tight against the pad.

2728.description: A front squat with a heavy load hugged to the chest, building quads and trunk strength.
instructions: Hold the load tight against your chest with your elbows up.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down keeping your chest tall.
Drive up through your heels.
Lock out the hips at the top.

2792.description: A jumping plank drill that raises your heart rate and challenges the core.
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Jump both feet out wide.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hips level and core tight.
Move at a steady pace.

2856.description: A balance and rolling move with the legs open in a V shape.
instructions: Sit and hold your ankles with your legs in a V.
Balance on your tailbone.
Roll back onto your shoulders.
Roll up to balance again.
Keep your back rounded.

2920.description: A single-leg hinge with your arms extended that trains hamstrings, glutes and balance.
instructions: Stand on one leg with arms reaching forward.
Soften your standing knee slightly.
Hinge at the hips as your free leg lifts behind you.
Keep your back flat and body in a long line.
Return to standing and repeat, then switch legs.

2984.description: A single-leg squat down to a box. The box gives you a target for depth as you build strength.
instructions: Stand in front of a box with one leg extended forward.
Brace your core and reach your arms forward for balance.
Sit back and down slowly on the standing leg until you touch the box.
Drive through your heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

3048.description: Standing hip abduction against a low cable that trains the outer hip and glutes.
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and strap it to your outer ankle.
Stand sideways to the machine and hold a support.
Keep your torso upright and your standing leg slightly bent.
Lift the cuffed leg out to the side.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps and switch legs.

3176.description: A straight-arm pullover with knees bent to 90 degrees on a bench. It works the chest and lats and keeps the trunk braced.
instructions: Lie on a bench with your feet up and knees at 90 degrees.
Hold one dumbbell with both hands above your chest.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Lower the dumbbell in an arc behind your head.
Pull it back over your chest.
Keep your ribs down and your back flat.

3240.description: A standing calf raise with your back on an exercise ball against a wall, dumbbells in hand, and a ball squeezed between the knees. It trains the calves and inner thighs.
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and place an exercise ball between your lower back and the wall.
Position your feet shoulder-width apart and slightly in front of you.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, with your arms extended by your sides.
Place a tennis ball between your knees.
Raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 背靠墙站立，将健身球放在下背部和墙壁之间。
将双脚分开与肩同宽，并稍微位于您的前方。
每只手握住一个哑铃，双臂伸向身体两侧。
将网球放在膝盖之间。
将脚后跟抬离地面，将身体抬起到脚趾上。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3304.description: A ring or bar move where you tuck up, pass the legs through the arms and then roll over the bar. It trains the back and shoulder mobility.
instructions: Start by hanging from a bar with your arms fully extended and your body relaxed.
Engage your core and lift your legs up, bringing your knees towards your chest.
Continue to lift your legs up and over your head, allowing your body to pass through the arms.
Once your legs are fully extended over your head, begin to lower them back down towards the starting position.
As you lower your legs, allow your body to pass back through the arms until you are hanging with your arms fully extended again.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先，将双臂完全伸展，身体放松地悬挂在杆上。
收紧核心并抬起双腿，使膝盖靠近胸部。
继续将双腿举过头顶，让身体穿过手臂。
一旦双腿完全伸过头顶，就开始将它们放回起始位置。
当你降低双腿时，让你的身体通过手臂向后移动，直到你再次完全伸展手臂悬挂。
重复所需的重复次数。

3368.description: A hip driven swing using a dumbbell, building power in your glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Stand with feet wider than hips and hold one dumbbell in both hands.
Hinge at the hips and swing the dumbbell between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to swing it to chest height.
Let your arms stay relaxed.
Guide it back down and hinge into the next rep.

3496.description: Alternating straight-leg raises while lying on your back, like a slow march. It trains the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie on your back, arms by your sides.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Raise one straight leg toward the ceiling.
Lower it as you raise the other leg.
Keep alternating in a slow, steady march.
Keep your back from arching.

3560.description: A standing dumbbell sequence that alternates hammer curls with overhead presses. It trains the biceps and shoulders.
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your back straight.
Exhale and curl the dumbbell in your right hand towards your shoulder, keeping your upper arm stationary.
Continue to raise the dumbbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbell is at shoulder level.
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat the curl with your left hand.
After completing the curl with your left hand, exhale and press the dumbbell in your right hand overhead.
Extend your arm fully and hold for a moment at the top.
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat the press with your left hand.
Continue alternating between curls and presses for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
保持肘部靠近躯干，背部挺直。
呼气，将右手的哑铃向肩膀弯曲，保持上臂静止。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
用左手重复卷发动作。
左手完成弯举后，呼气，将右手的哑铃压过头顶。
完全伸展手臂并在顶部保持片刻。
吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
用左手重复按压。
继续交替进行弯举和推举，达到所需的重复次数。

3688.description: A seated curl with an overhand grip that hits the forearms and brachialis hard along with the biceps.
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing down, arms hanging at your sides.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides and curl the weights up.
Stop when your forearms are near vertical and your wrists stay straight.
Lower the dumbbells slowly until your arms are fully extended.
Use a lighter weight than a normal curl.

3752.description: A lying curl where you pull a towel wrapped around your feet with your hands, so your legs provide resistance.
instructions: Lie on your back and wrap a towel around both feet, holding the ends.
Lift your legs slightly and press them against the towel.
Curl the towel toward your chest while your legs resist.
Lower slowly.
Keep your elbows at your sides.

3880.description: A one-arm lateral raise leaning away from a cable stack, giving constant tension on the side delt.
instructions: Stand sideways to a low pulley and hold the handle with the far hand.
Hold the upright support with the other hand and lean away from the machine.
Start with your working arm across your body.
Raise it out to shoulder height with a soft elbow.
Lower slowly under control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

3944.description: A seated crunch where you bring one knee and the opposite elbow together, then switch sides. It works the abs and obliques.
instructions: Sit on the floor, lean back slightly and lift your feet.
Place your hands behind your head.
Bring one knee in while rotating your torso toward it.
Return and repeat on the other side.
Keep your chest open and move with control.

4008.description: A sit up with straight legs. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl up to sitting.
Lower with control.
Do not pull on your neck.

4072.description: One leg squat with your back against a wall for balance. It builds single leg strength.
instructions: Lean your back on a wall and lift one foot off the floor.
Place your standing foot forward.
Slide down into a squat as far as you can control.
Press through your heel to rise.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

4136.description: A hip abduction with a band that crosses the body, working the outer hips.
instructions: Attach the band to a low anchor and loop it around your outer ankle.
Stand tall and hold support if needed.
Move that leg across then out to the side.
Control the return.
Switch legs after your set.

4200.description: A chest fly with chains adding load.
instructions: Lie on a bench with chains.
Hold weights above your chest.
Open arms.
Stretch your chest.
Bring weights together.
Keep elbows soft.

4328.description: A quick jumping drill where your legs swap front and back like scissors. Good for conditioning and coordination.
instructions: Stand tall with one foot forward and one back, arms ready.
Hop lightly and switch your leg positions in the air.
Swing your arms opposite to your legs for balance.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a quick, steady rhythm for the set.

4392.description: A seated V-shaped balance, also called boat pose, that works the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Sit with your knees bent and your feet on the floor.
Lean back slightly, keeping your chest lifted and back long.
Lift your feet and extend your legs into a V shape.
Reach your arms forward alongside your legs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.

4456.description: A posterior chain exercise on a glute ham bench. Works the hamstrings and glutes through a long range of motion.
instructions: Set your feet on the platform with your thighs against the pad and knees just behind it.
Start with your torso hanging down and your body straight.
Curl your body up by bending your knees and squeezing your hamstrings.
Finish with hips extended and torso upright.
Lower slowly with control, keeping your hips locked.
Repeat for reps.

4584.description: A curved punch thrown from the rear hand, rotating the torso to hit the side of the bag.
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance facing the bag.
Bend your right elbow to about 90 degrees.
Rotate your hips and torso to swing the fist in an arc.
Pivot your rear foot as you turn.
Hit the bag and keep your left hand guarding.
Return to your guard and repeat.

4776.description: A diagonal chop with a resistance band while kneeling. It trains the obliques and core.
instructions: Anchor a band high and kneel sideways to it.
Hold the handle with both hands.
Pull the band diagonally down across your body.
Rotate your torso as you chop.
Return slowly, then switch sides.

4840.description: A dead bug with straight legs lowering alternately. It is a tougher core challenge with a long lever.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms and legs straight up toward the ceiling.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor.
Return to the start and switch sides.
Keep your lower back flat the whole time.

4904.description: Quick small hops on the balls of your feet. It trains the calves and ankles and builds a springy stride.
instructions: Stand tall with feet close together and knees slightly bent.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Hop up quickly using mainly your ankles.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep your hops small and rhythmic.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

4968.description: A hamstring curl from hands and knees position. It works the back of the thigh.
instructions: Get on all fours with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core.
Curl one heel toward your glutes.
Squeeze the hamstring.
Lower slowly.
Finish reps, then switch legs.

5032.description: Raise your legs and crunch to the side. It targets the lower abs and the obliques together.
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your legs together toward the ceiling.
Crunch your shoulders up and toward one side as the legs tilt the other way.
Lower and repeat to the other side.
Keep movements slow and controlled.

5096.description: Squat while holding a dumbbell overhead with one arm. It builds leg strength and demands good shoulder and trunk control.
instructions: Press a dumbbell overhead with one arm and keep it locked out.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips back and down into a squat.
Keep your ribs down and the weight over your shoulder.
Drive up to standing, then switch arms after your reps.

5160.description: A push-up with hands close together on a raised surface. The easier angle keeps the focus on your triceps.
instructions: Place your hands close together on a bench or sturdy box, just under your chest.
Step back until your body is straight from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the edge, elbows tucked close to your ribs.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips from sagging throughout.

5224.description: A barbell shrug with a wide grip. It targets the upper traps.
instructions: Stand holding a barbell in front with a wide overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight and your chest up.
Lift your shoulders straight toward your ears.
Hold the top for a second.
Lower slowly under control.

5480.description: A seated stretch where you pull the foot toward you with a band. Lengthens the calf and the back of the leg.
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg straight and loop the band around the ball of that foot.
Hold the band ends with both hands and sit tall.
Gently pull your toes toward you.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, keeping your knee straight.
Release and switch legs.

5608.description: Standing chest press against a band anchored behind you.
instructions: Anchor a band behind you and hold the ends at chest height.
Stand in a split stance for balance.
Press your hands forward until arms are straight.
Return slowly.
Keep your core braced.

5672.description: A hip hinge with one foot staggered slightly behind. It biases one leg to train the hamstrings and glutes and builds balance.
instructions: Stand with one foot flat and the other slightly behind, toe resting on the floor.
Place your hands behind your head.
Push your hips back and hinge forward with a flat back.
Go down until you feel a stretch in the hamstring of the front leg.
Return to standing and switch legs after your set.

5800.description: Lie face down and raise your arms into a Y shape. It strengthens the lower traps and shoulder stabilizers.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead in a Y.
Turn your thumbs toward the ceiling.
Lift your arms off the floor, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

5864.description: A hip hinge swing with your arms moving like a kettlebell swing, but with no weight. It teaches the hip drive and warms up the glutes.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms hanging.
Hinge back at your hips and swing your arms between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and stand tall.
Let your arms float up to chest height.
Repeat in a smooth rhythm.

6056.description: A squat with arms swinging like waves while holding bottles. It raises your heart rate and works legs and shoulders.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, a bottle in each hand.
Squat down with your hips back.
As you stand, raise one arm up and the other down in a wave motion.
Switch arms on the next squat.
Move at a steady, controlled pace.

6120.description: The wind-relieving pose, where you hug your knees to your chest while lying down. It stretches the hips and lower back.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Bend your knees and draw them into your chest.
Wrap your arms around your shins and hug them in.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Breathe slowly and hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and extend your legs.

6440.description: A one-arm band move that pulls the arm out and back to the side. It works the shoulder and the muscles behind it.
instructions: Anchor the band at about waist height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with the far hand, arm across your body.
Keep your chest tall and core braced.
Sweep the arm out and slightly back to the side with a soft elbow.
Return slowly to the start without letting the band snap.
Complete all reps, then turn around and switch arms.

6632.description: A seated reach across the body toward the opposite foot. It loosens the trunk and works the obliques gently.
instructions: Sit tall on the front edge of a chair with feet flat.
Extend your arms out in front of you.
Reach one hand diagonally down toward the opposite foot, rotating your torso.
Return to upright with control.
Reach to the other side and keep alternating.

6760.description: A kneeling trunk rotation on a cable. It trains the obliques while the base stays stable.
instructions: Set a cable at chest height and kneel sideways to it.
Hold the handle with both hands in front of your chest.
Brace your abs and keep your hips square.
Rotate your torso away from the machine.
Return slowly under control.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

7208.description: A kneeling donkey-kick style move with band resistance for the glutes.
instructions: Start on hands and knees with the band around your foot and hands.
Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Kick one leg straight back and up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

7592.description: A rear delt fly with cables while your chest rests on an incline bench. It isolates the back of the shoulders.
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench between two cable stations.
Grab the opposite handles, arms hanging with a slight bend.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder level.
Pause and squeeze your rear delts.
Lower slowly without swinging.

8360.description: A light band drill that strengthens the internal rotators of the shoulder, handy for joint health.
instructions: Anchor the band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Tuck your elbow against your side with the forearm pointing forward.
Rotate your forearm across your belly, keeping the elbow fixed.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

8424.description: A seated punching drill that raises your heart rate and works the chest, shoulders and trunk.
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your fists to guard position.
Punch one arm across your body, rotating the trunk slightly.
Pull it back and punch with the other arm.
Keep a quick, smooth rhythm.

8616.description: A seated chest fly with bent elbows that squeezes the pecs by pressing the arms together.
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your elbows to chest height with forearms up.
Squeeze your elbows together in front of you.
Open them out again under control.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.

8744.description: A seated leg extension done by alternating legs, working the thighs without equipment.
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Straighten one knee by lifting the foot until the leg is level.
Squeeze your thigh, then lower slowly.
Switch legs and keep alternating.

9320.description: A close grip chin-up held at the top or halfway. It builds pulling strength and grip.
instructions: Grip the bar with palms facing you and hands close together.
Pull yourself up until your chin is over the bar.
Hold for 5 to 15 seconds.
Keep your shoulders down and core tight.
Lower slowly under control.
Rest and repeat.

9512.description: A pull-up with only one foot on a box for assistance. It is a step closer to a full pull-up.
instructions: Place a box under a pull-up bar.
Grip the bar and rest one foot on the box.
Pull up until your chin clears the bar.
Push lightly with the foot on the box.
Lower slowly.
Switch the assisting leg on the next set.

9704.description: A headstand variation using suspension straps for support. It builds balance and shoulder strength.
instructions: Set the straps at a low height.
Place your forearms or hands on the floor.
Lift your hips and place your feet in the straps.
Press your body up into a stable position.
Hold for 10 to 20 seconds.
Lower slowly and rest.

10536.description: Standing on one leg with a band behind the knee, you straighten the other knee. It builds quad strength with gentle load.
instructions: Anchor a band behind you and loop it around one ankle or behind the knee.
Stand tall and hold on for balance if needed.
Straighten your knee against the band.
Pause with the leg extended.
Bend slowly back, then switch legs after your reps.

10664.description: An advanced gymnastics skill where you press from a lean into a planche shape. It builds shoulder strength and a strong core.
instructions: Start in a deep planche lean with hands under your shoulders.
Protract your shoulders and squeeze your glutes.
Lean forward and lift your feet from the floor.
Press into the ground and hold the position.
Lower under control.
Warm up your wrists first.

10856.description: Reformer work with straps overhead. It trains the shoulders, abs and posture.
instructions: Sit or kneel on the carriage holding the straps overhead.
Brace your core.
Press the straps forward and down in a controlled arc.
Return to the overhead position.
Keep your spine tall.
Move smoothly with breath.

10920.description: Pressing the toes into the floor while seated. It activates the foot and calf muscles.
instructions: Sit on a chair with one foot on the floor.
Lift your heel slightly and press your toes into the floor.
Hold briefly.
Lower your heel again.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

11048.description: Seated, you press your knees outward. It trains the outer hips.
instructions: Sit tall with your knees bent and feet on the floor.
Place your hands on your outer knees.
Press your knees outward against your hands.
Hold briefly.
Release slowly.
Keep your back straight.

11880.description: A plate-loaded T-bar row with a close grip for thick back work.
instructions: Stand on the platform with your chest supported.
Grab the close-grip handle with straight arms.
Pull the handle toward your torso, elbows close.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly to full extension.

0040.description: Two moves in one: raise the bar in front to shoulder height, then take it back overhead. Hits the shoulders and chest.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Keep your arms straight and raise the barbell in front of you until it reaches shoulder height.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Next, lower the barbell behind your head, keeping your arms straight.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then raise the barbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，正手握住杠铃，手掌朝下。
保持双臂伸直，将杠铃举至身前，直至达到肩膀高度。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
接下来，将杠铃放低到头后，保持手臂伸直。
在底部停顿片刻，然后将杠铃举回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0104.description: A wrist curl with the bar held behind the back, building the grip and forearms.
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an overhand grip.
Rest the barbell on the back of your hands with your palms facing down and your fingers pointing towards your body.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl your wrists upwards as far as possible.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause, then inhale and slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，正手握住杠铃。
将杠铃放在手背上，手掌朝下，手指指向身体。
保持上臂静止，呼气并尽可能向上弯曲手腕。
保持收缩位置短暂停顿，然后吸气并慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0168.description: A cable hip adduction, bringing the leg across the body. Works the inner thighs.
instructions: Attach the ankle cuff to your ankle and stand facing the cable machine.
Position yourself far enough away from the machine so that there is tension on the cable.
Place your hands on the machine for support.
Keeping your leg straight, slowly move your leg across your body towards the midline.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将脚踝套戴到脚踝上，面向电缆机站立。
将自己放置在距离机器足够远的位置，以便电缆上有张力。
将手放在机器上以获得支撑。
保持腿伸直，慢慢将腿移向身体中线。
动作结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0232.description: A standing rope pulldown from a high pulley, pulling toward the thighs. It trains the arms and the lats.
instructions: Attach a rope to the cable machine at the highest setting.
Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the rope with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Keep your back straight and core engaged throughout the exercise.
Pull the rope down towards your thighs, squeezing your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly release the rope back up.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将绳索连接到最高设置的缆绳机上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
正手握住绳子，手掌朝下。
在整个练习过程中保持背部挺直并保持核心参与。
将绳子向下拉向大腿，挤压二头肌。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢地将绳子放回原位。
重复所需的重复次数。

0296.description: A close-grip dumbbell press with the weights held together. It places the load on the triceps.
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs.
Using your thighs to help raise the dumbbells, lift the dumbbells one at a time so that you can hold them in front of you at shoulder width.
Once at shoulder width, rotate your wrists forward so that the palms of your hands are facing away from you. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe in, slowly lower the dumbbells to your side until they are about level with your chest.
As you exhale, use your triceps to lift the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在平坦的长凳上，每只手各拿一个哑铃，放在大腿上。
用你的大腿帮助举起哑铃，一次举起一个哑铃，这样你就可以将它们保持在与肩同宽的位置。
一旦与肩同宽，向前旋转手腕，使手掌背向自己。这将是您的起始位置。
当你吸气时，慢慢地将哑铃降低到你的身边，直到它们与你的胸部齐平。
呼气时，用三头肌将哑铃举回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0360.description: A one-arm overhead dumbbell press, second variation. It trains the shoulder and triceps while your core resists leaning.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand at shoulder level, palm facing forward.
Engage your core and press the dumbbell straight up overhead, fully extending your arm.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to shoulder level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一只手握住哑铃，与肩同高，手掌朝前。
启动核心肌群，将哑铃垂直推过头顶，充分伸展手臂。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回肩部水平。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

0424.description: You press one dumbbell overhead with the palm facing in. It trains the shoulders and triceps, with a joint-friendly grip.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand at shoulder height with your palm facing inwards.
Engage your core and keep your back straight.
Press the dumbbell upwards until your arm is fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一只手握住哑铃，与肩同高，手掌朝内。
启动你的核心并保持背部挺直。
向上推哑铃，直到手臂完全伸展。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

0488.description: Lying face-down on a bench, you raise your torso and lower it. It builds the lower back, glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Adjust the hyperextension bench so that your hips are resting comfortably on the pad and your feet are secured.
Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands behind your head.
Slowly lower your upper body towards the ground while keeping your back straight.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then raise your upper body back up until it is in line with your legs.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整过度伸展凳，使臀部舒适地放在垫子上，并且双脚固定。
双臂交叉放在胸前或将双手放在脑后。
慢慢地将上半身降低到地面，同时保持背部挺直。
在底部停顿片刻，然后抬起上半身，直到与双腿成一直线。
重复所需的重复次数。

0552.description: You pull a kettlebell from between your thighs up to the rack position with both hands. Trains hip power, back and shoulders.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in front of your thighs with both hands, palms facing towards you.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge at the hips, lowering the kettlebell towards the ground.
Explosively extend your hips and knees, using the momentum to pull the kettlebell up towards your shoulders.
As the kettlebell reaches shoulder height, rotate your wrists and catch the kettlebell in the rack position, with your elbows tucked in and the kettlebell resting on the back of your forearm.
Lower the kettlebell back down to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住壶铃放在大腿前，手掌朝向自己。
稍微弯曲膝盖并铰接臀部，将壶铃降低到地面。
爆发性伸展臀部和膝盖，利用动量将壶铃拉向肩膀。
当壶铃达到肩膀高度时，旋转手腕，将壶铃放在架子上，肘部内收，壶铃放在前臂背面。
将壶铃放回起始位置，然后重复所需的重复次数。

0616.description: Lying near the edge of a surface, you let one leg hang to stretch the front of the hip. It eases tightness from sitting.
instructions: Lie on your back near the edge of a bench or bed.
Pull one knee toward your chest and hold it.
Let the other leg hang down relaxed over the edge.
Keep your lower back flat.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

0680.description: You climb a rope using your arms and legs. A full body pull that builds the grip, lats and arms.
instructions: Stand facing the rope with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grab the rope with both hands, palms facing towards you.
Bend your knees slightly and engage your core.
Begin pulling yourself up the rope by alternating hand-over-hand movements.
Use your legs to assist in the upward movement.
Continue climbing until you reach the desired height or the top of the rope.
To descend, reverse the hand-over-hand movement while controlling your descent.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 面向绳子站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
用双手抓住绳子，手掌朝向自己。
稍微弯曲膝盖并启动核心。
开始通过交替的双手动作将自己拉上绳子。
用双腿协助向上运动。
继续攀爬，直到到达所需的高度或绳索的顶部。
要下降，请在控制下降的同时反转双手的动作。
重复所需的重复次数。

0744.description: Lying on a sled, you bend your knees and press the platform away. Works the quads and glutes.
instructions: Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable weight.
Lie on your back on the sled machine with your feet on the footplate.
Position your feet shoulder-width apart and slightly angled outwards.
Grip the handles of the sled machine for stability.
Engage your glutes and core muscles.
Push through your heels and extend your legs to lift the sled.
Lower the sled back down by bending your knees and hips.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将雪橇机调整至舒适的重量。
仰卧在雪橇机上，双脚放在踏板上。
双脚分开与肩同宽，并稍微向外倾斜。
握住雪橇机的手柄以保持稳定。
调动你的臀肌和核心肌肉。
脚后跟用力，双腿伸直，抬起雪橇。
弯曲膝盖和臀部，将雪橇放回原位。
重复所需的重复次数。

0808.description: A bodyweight row with suspension handles, leaning back and pulling the chest to the hands. It trains the back and biceps.
instructions: Set up a suspension trainer at an appropriate height.
Stand facing the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the handles with an overhand grip, palms facing each other.
Lean back, keeping your body straight and your heels on the ground.
Pull your chest towards the handles, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower yourself back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将悬挂训练器设置在适当的高度。
面向锚点站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
正手握住手柄，手掌相对。
向后倾斜，保持身体挺直，脚后跟着地。
将胸部拉向手柄，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0872.description: A crunch that curls the hips off the floor with the knees bent. It targets the lower abs.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended along your sides.
Bend your knees and lift your feet off the ground, bringing your thighs perpendicular to the floor.
Contract your abs and curl your hips off the floor, bringing your knees towards your chest.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，双臂沿着身体两侧伸展。
弯曲膝盖，将脚抬离地面，使大腿垂直于地板。
收缩腹肌，将臀部卷离地板，使膝盖靠近胸部。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
